meta_description: The best 4-star hotels in Budapest compared: all rated 9 or higher, from €74 a night, most within a mile of downtown. Breakfast, sauna, pool and parking listed.
author_role: 8 four-star hotels, all rated 9 or higher, compared on price per night, location, breakfast and facilities
lead: Budapest is one of the few European capitals where a 4-star hotel rated 9 or higher, a short walk from the Opera or the Basilica, costs under €120 a night. All 8 hotels here score 9.0 or more from guests, and six of them cost €74–119. The differences are in the details: a pool and spa, the best breakfast, the lowest price or a garage (the #1 pick is Three Corners Avenue, €116, rated 9.3). This page gets you to the right one in under a minute.

I compared all 8 on what decides a 4-star stay: price for the same night, guest scores and their location and value sub-scores, breakfast rating, wellness facilities and parking, all from each hotel's live listing. Filter by wellness, price or parking below, or scroll straight to the ranking.

What the numbers say: the cheapest hotels are not the worst. Eurostars Ambassador (€74) and Ambra (€89) both score 9.1, the same as hotels costing €119. You pay more for two things: an indoor pool (Mamaison, €153) and an address a few steps from Váci utca (Emerald, €158). Want 5 stars instead? Compare the luxury hotels.

• The best all-rounder: #1 Three Corners Avenue.
  • A pool and spa: #2 Mamaison Chain Bridge.
  • The lowest price: #3 Eurostars Ambassador (€74).
  • The best location: #4 voco D8 (location 9.9).
  • The best breakfast: #5 EST Grand Savoy (rated exceptional).
  • Wheelchair access and a garage, central: #7 Barceló.

guide.h2: Before You Book a 4-Star in Budapest
guide.html:
Breakfast: most rates here show breakfast as optional; check the rate before you pay. EST Grand Savoy's breakfast is the one guests rate highest.

Parking: Eurostars Ambassador, Emerald, Barceló and Ambra list a garage (Ambra's has a size limit: cars up to 6.6 ft high and wide). The others have no parking listed.

Tourist tax: Budapest adds a local tourist tax to hotel stays; the booking page shows whether it is included.

faqs.q: What is the best 4-star hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: Three Corners Avenue Hotel is our #1: 9.3 from 3,224 reviews, value for money 9.3, a sauna, and 700 ft from the Opera metro, from €116 a night. Mamaison Hotel Chain Bridge has the highest score (9.5) and an indoor pool.

faqs.q: How much is a 4-star hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: The eight best-rated ones here cost €74 to €158 a night for 2 adults on a March weeknight; six of them cost €119 or less.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest good 4-star hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: Eurostars Ambassador, from €74 a night, rated 9.1 from 4,527 reviews, 900 ft from Oktogon, with a sauna, gym and garage.

faqs.q: Which 4-star hotel in Budapest has a pool?
faqs.a: Mamaison Hotel Chain Bridge Budapest has an indoor pool, spa, sauna and steam room. For more pools, see our spa hotels comparison.

faqs.q: Which 4-star hotel is closest to the centre?
faqs.a: Barceló Budapest on Király utca is 0.1 miles from downtown, and voco Budapest D8 on Dorottya utca has the best location score (9.9).

faqs.q: Are 4-star hotels in Budapest good value?
faqs.a: Yes. All eight here score 9.0 or higher, and six of them cost €119 or less for 2 adults on a March weeknight.

methodology: We compared official 4-star hotels in Budapest rated 9.0 or higher by guests on what decides the booking: the price for the same night (10 March 2027, 2 adults), the guest score and its location and value sub-scores, the breakfast rating, wellness facilities, parking and access, all from each hotel's live listing.
